implementation.guestPowerOff: OpenVMM exit:0; launcher closes owned video service; frontend records stopped and exitCode 0
implementation.guestReset: OpenVMM exit:75; launcher closes old service and relaunches fresh VMM/GPU with the same persistent disk, NVRAM and options
implementation.guestTripleFault: OpenVMM exit:70; faulted state, no automatic restart
implementation.hostPauseResume: Existing VMM pause/resume RPCs, status changes only after successful acknowledgements
implementation.eventDrain: Process exit waits for redirected output to drain before terminal state and UI exit event

limitations: One guest reboot and shutdown cycle, plus one pause/resume cycle; repeated long-duration qualification is not established.
Guest S3 sleep and hibernation resume are not implemented. The firmware/chipset handles S5 and S4, and MacHyperVSupport explicitly prevents unsupported sleep.
A root pmset sleepnow request returned success but no completed macOS Sleep/Wake cycle was recorded. This is not evidence of working S3.
Host pause retains volatile RAM and the live GPU context; it is not macOS S3 or a disk-backed snapshot and is lost on host shutdown or force-stop.
Ephemeral memdiff disks keep in-process guest reset; GPU restart with this diagnostic mode remains unqualified.
The host force-stop button and frontend close still send quit; normal shutdown should be requested in macOS.
Guest crash policy was checked by configuration and event tests; no live guest crash was injected.
privacy: No private screenshots, guest logs, credentials, media, or machine identifiers included. SSH used only for maintenance diagnostics and guest power commands.
